_readme: Ratchet control for the specification conformance harness (layers L1/L2/L3/L5).
mode = bootstrap  -> every gap is written to artifacts/spec/*.md and the job SUMMARY, but the
test suite still passes. Use this while the gap list is being triaged.
mode = enforce    -> gaps whose oracle entry has confidence=high fail the test run unless they
are listed in waivers[]. confidence=medium gaps stay advisory in both modes.
The intended workflow is one-directional: read artifacts/spec/gap-report.md, fix or waive every
high-confidence entry, then flip mode to enforce. Flipping back to bootstrap is a regression and
should be called out in review.
A waiver is a deliberate, documented divergence. 'reason' is mandatory and is reproduced in the
generated report so that nobody has to diff this file to understand the divergence.
maxChangedPixelRatio is the fraction of pixels allowed to differ by more than perChannelTolerance.
Text rasterisation differs between Linux/macOS/Windows Skia builds, so golden comparison is only
enforced on the baselineOs runner; elsewhere the diff is reported, never failed.

waivers.reason: Md.Comp.ComboBox.MenuItem.MinHeight is intentionally 72dp (two-line item with supporting text), which is a documented MdDecision rather than the 48dp single-line menu item.
